Here is the rate breakdown for a 6-month booking:

July: AED 7,500
August: AED 8,500
September: AED 9,500
October: AED 10,500
November: AED 14,500
December: AED 15,500

Please note that if you would like to confirm the 6-month booking, we will be happy to assist you. However, the first month and last month payments must be completed in advance to secure and confirm your reservation.

Thank you.
